stepTitle: In our subset, $$\text{critic\_2}$$ is a more helpful predictor variable than $$\text{critic\_1}.$$
stepBody:
We use a subset of $$	ext{skate\_record}$$ to train the model
$$\hat{y}=\hat{	heta}_0+\hat{	heta}_1x_1+\hat{	heta}_2x_2$$
where $$y$$ is self rating, $$x_1$$ is critic $$1$$ and $$x_2$$ is critic $$2$$.
The correlation matrix for the predictors and the response in this subset gives the following correlations:
• critic $$1$$ with critic 2: $$-0.70$$
• critic $$1$$ with self rating: $$0.10$$
• critic $$2$$ with self rating: $$-0.75$$
Each variable has a correlation of $$1.00$$ with itself.
